thesis: The podcast argues that the U.S. education and childcare sectors are resistant to change due to a lack of clear purpose, fragmented political incentives, and a history of spending hundreds of billions of dollars without achieving lasting results. It proposes that the most effective path forward involves partnerships between the private and public sectors to fill gaps in childcare deserts and drive innovation in how children are taught.
